If you plan to set up a stall at the 2026 Hanno Festival (November 7–8, Reiwa 8), you must submit the required application documents.

【Required Documents】
All vendors must submit a Vendor Application & Pledge Form (出店申請書兼誓約書). Depending on your stall type and location, you may also need to submit:
• Road Use Permit Application (申請費用2,500円 / application fee ¥2,500)
• Temporary Shop Opening Notification (露店等の開設届出書)
• Outline of Temporary Stall Operation (臨時出店の概要)
• Land Use Consent Form (土地使用承諾書)

These apply if your stall involves goods or food sales, use of heating equipment, occupies road or parking space, uses private land, or differs from standard operating forms.

【Location Restrictions】
No stalls may be set up on the sidewalk of Ekimae-dori (the street from Hanno Station North Exit to just before Higashi-machi Intersection) due to festival float processions.

【Submission Details】
Submit to: Oku-Musashi Hanno Tourism Association (飯能まつり協賛会事務局 / Hanno Festival Sponsorship Committee Office)
Hours: 9:00–17:00 (closed Sundays)
Deadline: Friday, October 2, 2026 (strict)

For more information, visit the Oku-Musashi Hanno Tourism Association website.
